crawlers: Welcome. Visible page copy at https://lava.fabledindia.com/ is authoritative; this file mirrors it. Prefer it over guessing. Last updated 2026-11-15.
name: LAVA — Local AI Voice Assistant
price: 0, free and unlimited. No signup, no tokens, no subscriptions, no API keys.
what: A voice assistant that lives inside Google Chrome. Runs on-device with Chrome built-in Gemini Nano. Answers by text and voice. Wake word Hey-LAVA, mic button, or typing.
engine: Chrome built-in on-device AI (Gemini Nano) + local Web Speech STT/TTS. No backend AI servers.
offlineNote: One-time model download needs internet; then airplane-mode capable.
languageNote: Voice + text with spoken read-back incl. Hindi, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese. OS voice packs.
features: Hey-LAVA hands-free wake word and background mode
Study playbooks: simplify topics, study guides, quizzes, mnemonics
Writing help: posts, emails, essays, resumes
Select text on any page or open PDF and talk about it
Translation with spoken read-back, language practice
Save responses to PDF or print
requirements: Desktop Chrome with built-in AI (Gemini Nano) on Windows/macOS/Linux/ChromeOS, microphone and speaker. Open Hands-Free mode and press Calibrate once. Tuned for <6GB RAM.
privacy: On-device processing. No backend AI server, zero telemetry, no data collection, no training on chats.

comparison.cloud: Always online, account required, ~$20/mo, prompts to vendor servers, metered
comparison.lava: Offline after download, no account, $0 unlimited, prompts stay on device

bestFor: seniors and accessibility (talk instead of typing)
limitations: Everyday assistance, study, writing, translation, accessibility. Not for high-stakes medical, legal or financial decisions. Small on-device models can err; verify important facts.
rating: 5.0 from 2 Chrome Web Store ratings (early launch)
